replay_procedure: A case may specify either input (a literal string) or repeat {unit, times}; the effective input is unit repeated times times. Both drivers must resolve it identically.
For every case: open a fresh fixture-mode engine over fixtures/w3 (no user dir).
1. lookup(input): reset the engine, type the input as one batch string, record input/composing/parsed_len and the full candidate list (text, kind, consumed_keys, consumed_bytes, cost, nbest_index).
2. If guess_sentence is true: run guess_sentence(); record whether the lookup ran, every sentence row's text, and the first 8 candidate texts after the rows prepend.
3. If candidates_at is set: build the re-anchored window at that byte offset; record text/kind/consumed_bytes for each candidate in it.

4. For every index in select: select that index of the CURRENT window; record result ('continued'/'completed'), composition_offset, preedit, composing, first 8 candidate texts after the selection, and — when completed — the commit() text. Stop after a selection completes.
A transcript event records exactly what the API returned at that step; on both sides (Rust native-dump binary and Python binding) the steps are identical and deterministic.
